name: Zapier
tagline: Connect your apps and automate routine tasks without code.
shortDescription: No-code automation platform for connecting web apps and automating multi-step workflows.
description: Zapier is a no-code automation platform that connects web apps. You build automations — called Zaps — where an event in one app triggers actions in others.
It is known for a large library of app integrations and a step-by-step builder that is approachable for non-technical users.
Zapier has a free plan and paid plans priced by usage. Count how many tasks your automations will run each month to estimate cost.

pricing.notes: Pricing is usage-based. Estimate monthly task volume before choosing a plan.

keyFeatures.title: Trigger–action automations
keyFeatures.description: When something happens in one app, automatically do something in another.

keyFeatures.title: Large integration library
keyFeatures.description: Connects a very large number of web apps. Check the official app directory for a specific app.

keyFeatures.title: Multi-step workflows
keyFeatures.description: Chain several actions together. Some advanced steps depend on the plan.

keyFeatures.title: Templates
keyFeatures.description: Start from pre-built automation templates for common tasks.

howItWorks: Create an account and click to create a new Zap.
Choose a trigger app and event.
Add one or more action steps and map the data.
Test, then turn the Zap on.
useCases: Saving email attachments to cloud storage
Adding new leads to a CRM
bestFor: Teams that use many different SaaS apps
notIdealFor: Very high-volume automation on a tight budget
Workflows that must run on your own servers
cons: Some features such as multi-step Zaps may depend on plan — check current details

checklist: Time for a beginner to build a three-step workflow (form → spreadsheet → email)
Free plan task allowance and step limits on the date of testing
Error notifications and replay options when a step fails
Availability of integrations for a list of 20 common apps

faqs.a: Zapier offers a free plan with limits, and paid plans for more tasks and features. Check the official pricing page for current limits.

faqs.q: Do I need to code to use Zapier?
faqs.a: No. Zapier is designed for no-code use, although optional code steps and webhooks are available for advanced users.
